vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #1887 — fix verify:cache-fresh --for-issue audit field

plan.title: verify:cache-fresh --for-issue reads issue_number from audit log

narratives.Description: The TS cache-fresh gate's per-issue path fails to match triage decisions because `parseCandidates` in preflight-cache reads `issue` instead of the canonical audit field `issue_number`. Operators see "no triage decision" after a valid accept, blocking the pre-dispatch gate stack.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Fix `packages/core/src/preflight-cache/evaluate.ts` `parseCandidates` to read `issue_number` (and `timestamp`) per `packages/core/src/triage/actions/candidates-log.ts` schema; align with queue reader in candidates-log.ts.
2. Add regression tests in `packages/core/src/preflight-cache/evaluate.test.ts` with audit rows using `issue_number` only (no legacy `issue` key).
3. Run `pnpm -w exec vitest run packages/core/src/preflight-cache/evaluate.test.ts` as verification evidence; CHANGELOG entry. Closes #1887.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator dispatching agents after triage:accept, I want verify:cache-fresh --for-issue to recognize the accepted issue, so that the pre-start_agent gate stack does not false-fail.
narratives.Overview: See issue #1887 — TS port regression in preflight-cache evaluate.ts parseCandidates field names.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an audit log row with `issue_number` and `timestamp` (no `issue` field), when `verify:cache-fresh --for-issue N` runs after accept, then the gate exits 0 and reports the latest accept decision.
Given unit tests in evaluate.test.ts with canonical audit schema rows, when vitest runs, then for-issue matching passes without requiring legacy `issue` key.
Given the fix lands, when CHANGELOG [Unreleased] is read, then it documents the cache-fresh for-issue gate fix. Closes #1887.
